question: Should Oracle own mutating ChatGPT Codex Cloud security-finding actions, or should this feature initially remain read-only?
rationale: Creating PRs, sending finding chat, and closing or adjusting findings establishes a new authenticated operational boundary whose permanent product ownership cannot be inferred from code correctness.

options.title: Ship read-only first
options.body: Land list and detail inspection after the filtering fix, and defer mutation commands until maintainers explicitly sponsor them.

options.title: Sponsor full actions
options.body: Keep all actions after the correctness fixes and inspectable current-head proof demonstrate safe targeting and completion.

options.title: Decline the integration
options.body: Do not add a Codex security-findings workflow to Oracle.

recommendation.title: Ship read-only first
recommendation.body: Land list and detail inspection after the filtering fix, and defer mutation commands until maintainers explicitly sponsor them.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the adjacent Project Sources browser workflow and is the strongest current-main owner for Oracle's authenticated browser product boundary.
